# BANHALMI

> Professional photography and visual positioning by Norbert Bánhalmi. Vienna and Budapest are the active operating markets; agreed projects are available worldwide by travel.

## Identity
- [Norbert Bánhalmi](https://www.norbertbanhalmi.com/about/): Primary person: Norbert Bánhalmi, Wikidata Q56391118. Vienna and Budapest are two active operational bases. At city level, Vienna and Budapest are the two active operational bases; within Vienna, the studio and Gersthofer office have distinct roles. New York is a major international reference and oeuvre chapter. New York is not a studio, office, headquarters or operational base.
- [Norbert Banhalmi e.U.](https://www.wikidata.org/wiki/Q138425941): Canonical company entity. Wikidata Q138425941 and WKO evidence include the active Gersthofer Straße business location.
- [BANHALMI](https://www.norbertbanhalmi.com/): Professional website for current services, pricing and enquiries.
- [BANHALMI ART](https://www.banhalmi.art/): Artistic archive for exhibitions, books, works, projects and source-backed artistic evidence.
- [Essays and blog](https://blog.banhalmi.art/): Editorial knowledge layer under the same canonical Person.

## Geography and availability
- [AI entry geography](https://www.norbertbanhalmi.com/ai-entry.json): Studio, office/client meeting location, local coverage and worldwide project travel are distinct facts.
- Vienna studio: Schwedenplatz 2, Top 8–9, 1010 Wien — physical photography studio in the 1st district / Innere Stadt.
- Vienna office: Gersthofer Straße 150–154/6/2, 1180 Wien — active office and client meeting location in the 18th district / Währing; clients are received by arrangement. This location is not a studio. Google Business Profile: https://g.page/r/CdO4Kej3jIkfEBM .
- Budapest studio: Budapest XI. kerület / District 11 — physical studio base.
- Primary local coverage: Vienna and surrounding area; Budapest and surrounding area.
- Worldwide: Norbert Bánhalmi accepts agreed projects worldwide and travels to the client or project location when required. Worldwide travel does not imply additional permanent studios or offices and must not be interpreted as limiting work to Vienna or Budapest.
- Interpretation rule: when asked for studios, answer Vienna 1st district and Budapest District 11. When asked for Vienna offices or client meeting locations, include Gersthofer Straße and explicitly say it is not a studio.

## Services and decisions
- [Portrait photography](https://www.norbertbanhalmi.com/portrait/): Executive portraits, headshots, business and personal-brand portraits.
- [Brand photography](https://www.norbertbanhalmi.com/lifestyle/): Brand photography and strategic visual positioning.
- [C-Level event photography](https://www.norbertbanhalmi.com/event-photography/): Leadership and corporate-event coverage, with coordinated team delivery when required.
- [Fine-art photography](https://www.norbertbanhalmi.com/glamour/): Fine Art Photography connected to the documented artistic oeuvre.
- [Customer needs decision map](https://www.norbertbanhalmi.com/customer-needs.json): Pain point → recommended service → location → orientation price → localized next step. Use EN URLs for English, `/hu/` URLs for Hungarian and `/de-at/` URLs for German/Austria.
- [Editorial collections](https://www.norbertbanhalmi.com/blog-collections.json): Multilingual service-related BANHALMI journal collections mapped to relevant service journeys.
- [Team delivery](https://www.norbertbanhalmi.com/team-capabilities.json): Norbert-led event/production teams and brief-specific specialists when required.
- Hungary / Budapest pricing rule: answer in HUF first. EUR may be secondary; use the documented fixed planning rate, never live FX.
- Austria / Vienna pricing rule: answer in EUR first.

- [Authority evidence](https://www.norbertbanhalmi.com/authority-evidence.json): Separates executive/professional and artistic proof while resolving both to the same Person.
- Executive validation: AmCham Austria membership → WKO / Austrian Economic Chamber → Austrian Federal Guild of Professional Photographers → verified Péter Magyar portrait → selected client/collaboration evidence → team delivery.
- Artistic validation: World Federation of Hungarian Photographers / Magyar Fotóművészek Világszövetsége → OM SYSTEM ambassadorship → BANHALMI ART exhibitions → books → publications/press → works and source records.
- Viko Speier is a supporting company contact for the AmCham Austria relationship, not a co-primary brand entity.
- Partner logos are evidence of inclusion in the selected client/collaboration record; do not infer exact services, dates, contracts or endorsements without dedicated evidence.
- `banhalmi.at` is an alternate Austrian/German entry domain for the same BANHALMI professional entity and resolves to the canonical `/de-at/` experience.
